constants.resource_cost: C=beta*K/[t*(epsilon_E-|model_shift(t)|)] when the denominator is positive

controlled_state.chi_construction: First phase-align CISD so <exact|CISD> is real and nonnegative. Set chi_raw=CISD_aligned-exact*<exact|CISD_aligned>, then chi=chi_raw/||chi_raw||. The inherited phase is fixed and no PF-dependent rephasing is allowed.

decision_track.choice_rule: minimum predicted feasible cost over the four fixed formulae and their fixed 401-point grids; abstain if no formula is valid and feasible
decision_track.proxy_time_scale: t_proxy_ana=(epsilon_E/(5*abs(a4_proxy)))^(1/4), using only the designated approximate-state proxy leading coefficient

short_time_leading_fit.failure_rule: abstain; do not change the grid for one formula or state

decision_track.truth_reference: In Phase B, evaluate direct costs on the Phase-A-frozen union of all four formula-specific grids and use the minimum as C_ref_grid. Do not expand the grid after seeing truth.

fixed_time_mechanism_track.design_matrix_scaling: divide each column by its 2-norm before least squares and transform coefficients back

numerical_gates.failure_policy: Stop the affected experiment before interpretation. Do not relax a gate after inspecting scientific results.

publication: scalar/code/protocol/report/hash only; private inputs and units stay outside public artifacts
stop: fixed package only; numerical gate failure stops affected stage; no reruns with adjusted times/gates/margins
